manuscript_v1_or_companion: Protocol described as nested; Fig. 1 lists imputation, scaling and oversampling as refitted in each inner fold
observed_in_code: Imputation, scaling and SMOTE are refitted per inner fold, but SHAP feature selection is fitted ONCE on the whole outer-training partition before the inner loop; the inner-CV metrics that drive model selection therefore use features chosen with the inner validation rows (selection bias in the internal estimate; held-out set unaffected)
impact_on_eight_runs: Affects runs where selection removed features (p > n_keep): Wisconsin (31 -> 20); possibly Stroke. Inflates internal (CV) metrics, including the CV sensitivity used by the hard floor
resolution_needed: Move selection inside each inner fold, or report CV metrics as optimistic

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Score S = 0.4 A + 0.4 (M+1)/2 - 0.2 clip(E) - max(0, 0.80 - sigma)^1.5 on inner-CV means; hard floor on CV mean sensitivity; fallback to highest score with piso_sensibilidade_atingido=False
observed_in_code: As stated
impact_on_eight_runs: none

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Schema detection 'admits every numeric column that is not the label'
observed_in_code: A column is numeric only if every non-empty value in the FIRST 30 ROWS parses as float; a column with a non-numeric missing-value token (e.g. 'N/A') in those rows is treated as categorical and, with >20 distinct values, silently discarded
impact_on_eight_runs: Stroke: bmi is the only column with missing values and encodes them as 'N/A'; the reported 'imputation: none' is consistent with bmi having been excluded
resolution_needed: Publish the per-run schema (retained feature names)

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Wisconsin listed with 31 inputs 'i.e. the 30 measurements plus the id column'; no ID handling described
observed_in_code: No identifier filtering in detectar_schema: any numeric ID column (Wisconsin 'id', Stroke 'id') enters X. In the lineage branch, earlier outputs ranked 'id' as the top feature for Wisconsin and Stroke
impact_on_eight_runs: Wisconsin and Stroke models may use a row identifier; any signal it carries is an artefact of file ordering
resolution_needed: Drop identifier columns; report whether 'id' survived SHAP selection

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Scaling chosen per dataset 'by an agent rule'
observed_in_code: Deterministic rule (no LLM involved): RobustScaler if the pooled IQR-outlier share > 0.08 OR fewer than 50 % of features pass Shapiro-Wilk (p > 0.05); else StandardScaler. Image runs always use StandardScaler (treinar() calls treinar_vetores with defaults)
impact_on_eight_runs: Shapiro-Wilk rejects normality for almost any feature at n in the thousands, so large tables default to RobustScaler
resolution_needed: State thresholds; record chosen scaler per run

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Descriptors include 'GLCM contrast, homogeneity, energy and entropy'
observed_in_code: Entropy is first-order (grey-level histogram) entropy, not a GLCM property; GLCM uses a single offset (distance 1, angle 0 rad), 256 levels, symmetric, normalised
impact_on_eight_runs: Texture description is direction-specific; 'GLCM entropy' is mislabelled

manuscript_v1_or_companion: 'percentile (1-99) normalization in place of min-max'
observed_in_code: The default (non-percentile) branch of the adaptive path divides by 255; no per-image min-max is applied. Resizing to 256x256 ignores aspect ratio (cv2.resize)
impact_on_eight_runs: Descriptive only

manuscript_v1_or_companion: CLAHE (2.0, 8x8), NL-means (h=0.1) instead of Gaussian, percentile 1-99; chosen per run by rule
observed_in_code: As stated; rule thresholds: noise sigma > 0.05 -> NL-means; >10 % intensity outliers -> percentile; mean contrast < 30 -> CLAHE (NL-means also uses patch 5, distance 6, fast mode)
impact_on_eight_runs: none

manuscript_v1_or_companion: SHAP selector: RF probe on training fold, top n = max(2, min(p, n_train/3, 20)) by mean |SHAP|
observed_in_code: As stated, but SHAP values are computed on a random subsample of at most 200 training rows
impact_on_eight_runs: Minor

manuscript_v1_or_companion: SMOTE and SHAP selection 'enabled by default'; their runtime status is not in the reports
observed_in_code: balancear() and selecionar_features_shap() catch every exception (including ImportError) and return the data unchanged. requirements.txt omits scikit-learn, shap, imbalanced-learn, which pyproject.toml/uv.lock declare; the two install routes can therefore yield different pipelines without any error
impact_on_eight_runs: Whether oversampling and feature selection ran in the eight runs is unknown
resolution_needed: Log info_balanceamento / selecao_features_shap per run; pin environment

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Table V 'LLM (s)': 'Local language-model generation ... accounts for 789.2 of the 809.5 s' (Brain Tumor)
observed_in_code: For image runs the timed interval wraps the whole CrewAI kickoff, whose agents call tools that run base analysis, preprocessing + feature extraction of every image, and the full AutoML protocol. The column is crew wall time, not generation time
impact_on_eight_runs: Runs 02, 05, 06: LLM generation time is not identifiable; runs 01, 03, 04, 07, 08 (tabular): crew call precedes AutoML, so the remainder of end-to-end time is mostly AutoML

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Narrative reports generated from the run's results (companion study)
observed_in_code: In tabular mode the LLM narrative is produced BEFORE classifier training, so it cannot reflect the classifier results shown in the same report
impact_on_eight_runs: Narratives of runs 01, 03, 04, 07, 08 are independent of their AutoML output
resolution_needed: Generate narrative after training or label it as descriptive statistics only

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Selection by clinical score with sensitivity floor among six candidates
observed_in_code: Agent/task prompts and the training tool's returned text describe two models (SVM, RF) and 'best model = highest AUC'; the image-mode narrative is prompted with a selection rule the code does not use
impact_on_eight_runs: Image narratives (runs 02, 05, 06) may misstate how the model was selected

manuscript_v1_or_companion: 'Training takes 0.035-1.959 s'
observed_in_code: tempo_treino_s is one final fit of the selected model on the balanced training set; it excludes the 6x15 inner-CV fits and the SHAP probe. Inference latency times predict() only (not predict_proba) and is divided by test size. The UI labels the training time '5-fold CV'
impact_on_eight_runs: Table V training times understate the cost of the AutoML step

manuscript_v1_or_companion: Six classifiers with balanced class weights (LR, SVM, RF)
observed_in_code: Two divergent trainers exist: classificador.treinar_vetores (used by the eight runs: tabular and image folders; class weights, imputation, SHAP selection, rule-based scaler) and avaliacao_modelos.avaliar_modelos (used for DICOM, signal and volume modes; no class weights, no imputation, no SHAP selection, StandardScaler only, latency per batch)
impact_on_eight_runs: None for these runs; results do not transfer to other modalities
resolution_needed: Unify trainers or document per modality

manuscript_v1_or_companion: 'All use random_state=42'

manuscript_v1_or_companion: ECE: ten equal-width half-open bins; p = 1.0 excluded
